content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for RGU Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Rajiv Gandhi University (RGU) under an ICSSR funded project.

faq.question: Q2. What are the positions available in RGU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available positions are Research Assistant and Field Investigator, totaling two temporary vacancies.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for these posts?
faq.answer: The mode of application is purely through a walk-in interview scheduled directly at the university campus.

faq.question: Q4. What is the date for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held on 27 October 2026 at Rajiv Gandhi University.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Research Assistant position will receive a fixed salary of Rs. 47,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the Field Investigator post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Field Investigator position will receive a salary of Rs. 20,000 per month.

faq.question: Q7. What educational qualification is required for the Research Assistant?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Post Graduate degree in a Social Science discipline with 55% marks, along with NET/M.Phil/Ph.D and project research experience.

faq.question: Q8. What educational qualification is required for the Field Investigator?
faq.answer: Applicants must hold a Post Graduate degree in a Social Science discipline with a minimum of 55% marks.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I bring to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring all original testimonials and certificates, a self-attested photocopy of the same, and an updated CV or bio-data.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee for applying to RGU posts?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification released by Rajiv Gandhi University for these positions.
